metadata.scenario_context: A team of IT programmers from different multinational companies is collaborating on a project that is scheduled to launch in August. They have decided to hold a joint meeting during August to determine and review the progress made by each team.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada disagree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Kenya agree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose and discuss holding the meeting on the 9th of August.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is common to discuss the appropriateness of government actions.

agent_2.goal_1: Discussion on setting a specific meeting date in August.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to discuss government actions.
